title: The project runtime does not create, update, or delete users or organisations on Clerk
iWant: the project's request lifecycle to leave user and organisation management to Clerk's own surfaces
soThat: identity state has one authoritative home and the project does not accumulate a split-brain user table that drifts from Clerk

acceptanceCriteria.description: A source-tree scan finds no request-lifecycle call to Clerk's user-create, user-update, user-delete, organisation-create, organisation-update, or organisation-delete Backend API endpoints outside a project-authored provisioning script directory.
acceptanceCriteria.given: the project's source tree after the blueprint's TACs are realised
acceptanceCriteria.when: a scan enumerates every call to Clerk's Backend API mutation endpoints
acceptanceCriteria.then: every match resolves to a file under a directory conventionally named `scripts/provisioning/` (or the project's declared equivalent); no match resolves to a request handler, a middleware, or a runtime module served by the project's HTTP surface

acceptanceCriteria.description: The middleware's session verifier and claims mapper do not mutate Clerk state as a side effect of verification; a scan of the session verifier module finds no calls to Clerk Backend API mutation endpoints.
acceptanceCriteria.given: the session verifier module (TAC-1003) and the claims mapper module (TAC-1004) after the blueprint's TACs are realised
acceptanceCriteria.when: a scan enumerates every Clerk SDK call the two modules make
acceptanceCriteria.then: every match resolves to a read-shaped operation (session verification, organisation membership lookup); no match resolves to a Clerk mutation endpoint
